text:
Jamie Park: Hi team — first-day question: I can't find the "Product Spec - Template (Canonical)" in Notion. The onboarding link says "You don’t have access". Anyone know where the canonical spec template lives or who to ask for access?

Alex Chen: hey @Jamie Park — welcome! The canonical templates live in the Engineering & Product > Templates space in Notion. Link: https://redwood.notion.so/Engineering-Product-Templates-abc123 (if the link 404s, it's probably permissions).

Lila Gómez: hi! devex usually manages access. You can click the blue "Request access" button on the page or ping #devex in this channel. If you request access, include your email and the exact page title so we can approve faster.

Jamie Park: I clicked request access but haven't heard back. Is there a faster person to ping?

Samir Patel: @Alex Chen or @Lila Gómez can approve, but the quickest is to DM @devex and paste the page title. If you need edit rights immediately, mention you need "Editor" role.

Alex Chen: I'll look now — which name did you try to open? There are a couple of templates.

Jamie Park: The canonical one. Full title I saw in the onboarding doc is: "Product Spec - Template (Canonical)".

devex-bot: Access request received for page "Product Spec - Template (Canonical)" from Jamie Park. Processing...

Alex Chen: done — gave Jamie Park Editor on that page and added them to the Owners property. Try refreshing Notion and duplicating into your workspace.

Jamie Park: got it! I can open and duplicate the template now. Thank you :tada:

Lila Gómez: quick tips — to add the template to your personal workspace: Open the page > ••• menu > Duplicate > choose "My workspace". For team-wide templates, place the page under Engineering & Product > Templates and set the "Template" property to True so it shows up in the templates index.

Jamie Park: another quick q — where is the engineer onboarding checklist (laptop + accounts + slack invites)?

Samir Patel: that lives at Engineering -> Onboarding -> "Engineer Checklist". Link: https://redwood.notion.so/Engineer-Checklist-xyz789. I can share it with you if you still can't access.

Alex Chen: also to pin pages: open the checklist page > ••• > Add to sidebar so you can get back to it fast.

Jamie Park: added to sidebar, can access checklist, and duplicated the spec template. Thanks everyone! Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
